violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE HANDLED RAW BEEF PATTIES WITH BARE HANDS AND PROCEED TO HANDLE UTENSILS AND SALT SHAKER WITHOUT WASHING HANDS.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS, REPLACE SALT SHAKER AND REMOVE UTENSILS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: ASIAGO RANCH DRESSING AT 55F IN 3 DOOR REACH THRU PREP UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS SURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: SLICED TOMATOES AT 47-51F IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR FOR 5 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 DOOR UNDER COUNTER UNIT AT 54F IN DRIVE THRU.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNIT UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TCS FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on MOP SINK FAUCET WHICH CONNECTS THE CHEMICAL DISPENSING SYSTEM TO the water supply system:
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE FORWARD EVIDENCE OF PURCHASE OF APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE WITHIN 3 DAYS AND SUBSEQUENT INSTALLATION TO EHS.
